messages:
Maya (Product): Quick sync: customer asked for a prefetch pilot with short burst capacity + HSM keys. Need cross-team sequencing and launch gates. Who can own the plan?
Jin (Eng): We can handle burst routing but runtime needs async batching + KV cache tweaks. Priya, how long to stabilize?
Priya (Runtime): Async batching + cache policy toggles ~2 sprints with 2 engineers. Need a harness for long-tail sequence lengths and a canary pool to validate. Also require pinable model variant for fallback.
Alex (Infra): Canary/dedicated burst pool ok. Infra work: reserve capacity, autoscale policy, VPC routing for HSM. Estimate ~8 dev-days incl. testing. Need target sustained RPS and burst window to size.
Sam (Security): HSM path: if customer wants on-prem HSM add compliance gap analysis + DMZ. Cloud KMS with HSM-backed keys is faster. I'll start the threat model next Wed.
Nora (PMM): Marketing note: customer expects SLA language. For pilot we should call it "pilot SLO" and be explicit about capacity limits.
Maya (Product): Proposed launch gates: 1) customer acceptance tests pass; 2) p50 <=150ms for 512 tokens on dedicated pool; 3) automatic fallback to hosted-compatible model variant; 4) security signoff for keys. Additions?
Jin (Eng): Add perf regression suite gated in CI and a chaos test that kills the dedicated pool to verify fallback. Document quantization vs. quality tradeoffs in the spec.
Priya (Runtime): Agreed. We'll provide per-tenant pin flag and canary routing policy. Need a small canary slice from infra.
Alex (Infra): Opening INFRA ticket and reserving slot. Action: product -> expected sustained RPS and burst QPS by EOD so we can size the pool.
Sam (Security): If HSM review slips, fallback: customer-managed KMS + runtime audit logs + accelerated key rotation. I'll draft checklist and approvals.
Maya (Product): Action owners: Jin -> perf test PR and CI gating; Priya -> runtime fallback/canary design; Alex -> infra ticket & autoscale runbook; Sam -> HSM checklist & threat model; Nora -> customer comms draft. I'll update roadmap and share the spec. :thumbsup:
Jin (Eng): Local perf command: `./run_perf --model prefetch-pilot-v1 --tokens 512 --concurrency 8 --dur 60s`
deploy-bot: INFRA-7620 created: reserved window 2024-09-20..2024-09-30 for canary pool testing
Maya (Product): Thanks. Please flag blockers here. Reconvene Tue 11am unless issues.
Priya (Runtime): Note: include one quantized and one FP16 variant in runtime tests to measure latency vs. quality.
Alex (Infra): Sending RPS ask now. DM me for early access to canary pool.
Sam (Security): External auditor availability may delay HSM review; I'll surface options in the security doc.
Maya (Product): Copy. Tracking in the roadmap card.
